To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the hemp seed oil is able to supply sow milk with ALA and SCA, which is converted to the LCPUFA C20:5 and C22:6n 3 by the piglets, which in turn results in a better body weight gain and higher glucose concentration in plasma.

hemp seed oil supplementation to lactating sowe resulted in transfer of ALA and SAD, and that these fatty acids were converted by the piglet to C20: 5n 3, and C22: 5n3, and the hemp seed oil supplementation also resulted in improved piglet body weight gain during first days of life and increased glucose concentration in plasma.

the fatty acid composition in sow plasma and milk fat was altered by dietary fat source and that piglet's plasma fatty acid composition and some of their physiological parameters were influenced by the maternal dietary fatty acid composition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transfer of hemp seed oil fatty acids from the mother sow to piglets, and the effect on nutritional and immune status.
the potential of the hemp seed oil as a dietary supplement to sow diets.
the effect of hemp seed oil in sow nutrition and transfer to the off spring.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dietary hemp seed oil is a good alternative to soybean oil in the diets of lactating sows and that the fatty acid profile of the oil can be transferred to the off spring.
dietary hemp seed oil has a positive effect on sow's milk production, and that the piglet's immune status is improved by the hemp seed oil supplementation.
hemp seed oil is a promising source for ALA, SDA, and other n 3 LCPUFA, which can be transferred to the offspring via milk and may influence their health status.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
dietary hemp seed oil supplementation to lactating sowing could be an option to increase the proportion of LCPUFA in milk and to improve piglet health and growth.
dietary hemp seed oil is a valuable alternative source of n 3 LCPUFA to piglets.
hemp seed oil is a valuable source of ALA and SCA for lactating sows and their piglets, and it can be used in pig diets as alternative to soybean oil.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hemp seed oil can be considered as an alternative source of n 3 LCPUFA in sow diets.
hemp seed oil is a valuable source of n 3 LCPUFA for the sow and her piglets.
hemp seed oil can be used in piglet nutrition, but further research is needed to elucidate the mechanisms behind these findings.
